tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtso 'dus brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/

rdor 'chang nai gu khyung po rmog cog pa/ /skyer sgang gnyan ston sangs ston shangs ston pa/ /tshul mgon ras chen shangs dkar skyud lung pa/ /nam rgyal rgya sgom rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /grol mchog lhar grags kun rgyal sgrol ba'i mgon/ /kun mtshon byams mgon lhun blo 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ grags pa blos stobs 'jigs med rnam par rgyal/ /chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i sde la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal/ bde kyai 'jigs gsang mahā ma ya sogs/ /gtso mchog lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rab gus gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / gtum mo'i bde drod sgyu ma'i rang nyams dang*/ /rmi lam rang zin rtsol med 'od gsal shar/ /'pho med legs rtogs bar do dang po la/ /rang sems longs skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'di'i thog mtha'i sho lo ka gnyis po ni rje grol mchog gi rdo rje'i ljags kyis stsal ba dngos yin la/ bar gyis kha bskang gi sho lo ka zung ni dharma wārta'i gnang ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ kyai ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing*/ /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru kar bsgom bya/ / lan gsum/ ye shes lnga ni/ sngon po mi bskyod pa/ ljang gu don yod grub pa/ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/ ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/ dmar po snang ba mtha' yas so/ gtso 'dus brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/gtso 'dus brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/ - PAGE 238 -- PAGE 237 -- PAGE 236 -
